<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions (up to 40) with the given energy and count limits, then consolidate the individual JSON files into a single dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "Fe2O3","TiO2","Al2O3","SiO2","ZnO","CuO","MnO","CoO","NiO","Cr2O3",
        "MgO","CaO","SrO","BaO","PbO","SnO2","V2O5","MoO3","WO3","ZrO2",
        "HfO2","CeO2","Y2O3","La2O3","Nd2O3","Sm2O3","Gd2O3","In2O3","Ga2O3","Bi2O3",
        "Ti3O5","FeO","Cu2O","PbO2","Sb2O5","TiO","SiO","GeO2"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_5/polymorph_data"
}
</action_input>
